data.title: Property management, handled.
data.body: Practical support for your property, your tenants and your long-term investment.

data.image_alt: Gani Property Services office in Balham
data.title: A hands-on team for hands-off ownership
data.body:
Managing a rental property involves far more than collecting rent. Marketing, tenant communication, maintenance, documentation and renewals all require time and consistent attention.
Our fully managed service brings those responsibilities together through one accountable local team. We look after the day-to-day details, keep you informed and help protect the experience of both landlord and tenant.

items.title: One local team
items.text: A consistent point of contact throughout the tenancy.

items.title: Proactive care
items.text: Issues coordinated early to reduce disruption and cost.

data.title: Management from move-in to renewal
data.intro: Our service is designed to reduce day-to-day demands while keeping you connected to important decisions about your property.

cards.title: Valuation & marketing
cards.text: Rental advice, considered presentation, enquiries and accompanied viewings aimed at finding the right tenant.

cards.title: Tenant onboarding
cards.text: Referencing coordination, agreements, deposit administration, inventory arrangements and a clear move-in process.

cards.title: Rent collection
cards.text: Scheduled rent collection, statements and prompt follow-up if a payment does not arrive as expected.

cards.title: Maintenance coordination
cards.text: A responsive point of contact for tenants, with repairs assessed and suitable contractors coordinated with your approval.

cards.title: Inspections & updates
cards.text: Periodic visits and practical reporting to help identify upkeep requirements and support good tenant relationships.

cards.title: Renewals & check-out
cards.text: Rent review guidance, renewal conversations and organised check-out support when a tenancy comes to an end.

data.title: Supporting reliable income and long-term value
data.body: Good management helps reduce avoidable voids, keeps maintenance organised and creates a better experience for reliable tenants. We balance everyday decisions with your longer-term plans for the property.

items.title: Responsive tenant communication
items.text: Questions and maintenance reports handled through a clear point of contact.

items.title: Informed landlord decisions
items.text: Options, costs and material issues explained before action is taken.

items.title: Organised tenancy records
items.text: Key documents, statements and communications kept together throughout the tenancy.

data.title: A straightforward route to a managed tenancy
data.intro: Clear stages, regular communication and one local team from appraisal onward.

items.title: Rental appraisal
items.text: We discuss your property, priorities, likely rent and the level of service you need.

items.title: Prepare & market
items.text: Presentation, marketing, viewings and applicant communication are coordinated.

items.title: Agree the tenancy
items.text: Referencing, documentation, deposit arrangements and move-in are brought together.

items.title: Manage day to day
items.text: We handle rent, tenant queries, maintenance coordination and scheduled updates.

items.title: Review & renew
items.text: We discuss rent, renewal options and next steps ahead of key tenancy dates.

data.note: Landlords remain responsible for meeting their legal obligations. Our team can help coordinate the practical steps and documentation associated with a managed tenancy.

data.body: Book a no-obligation rental appraisal and talk through the right management service for your investment.
